headline: Binance Resumes Initial Phase of Withdrawals Following Hacker Attack
summary: Binance resumed the first phase of withdrawals following a temporary suspension caused by a hacker attack, while deposits remained open and unaffected.
why: Cryptocurrency exchanges are central infrastructure for digital asset liquidity; security breaches and withdrawal freezes can trigger widespread market volatility and loss of user confidence.

impacts.name: Binance
impacts.why: The platform's operations and user withdrawal services were directly interrupted and then partially restored.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: A security breach and subsequent suspension of withdrawals at a major crypto exchange heightens operational risk and liquidity concerns across digital asset markets.
